subject.title: fix(codex): bound app-server websocket handshake waits to requestTimeoutMs

question: Should `appServer.requestTimeoutMs` remain the single operator-controlled ceiling for both Codex app-server RPCs and WebSocket/Unix connection upgrades?
rationale: The patch fixes an indefinite wait without introducing a second setting, but it changes the meaning of an existing timeout for configured installations; only the Codex product owner can decide whether that tradeoff is the intended long-term contract.

options.title: Accept the shared timeout contract
options.body: Approve the documented reuse of `requestTimeoutMs` for stalled TCP and Unix upgrades, then refresh the branch and required merge checks.

options.title: Define a separate handshake policy
options.body: Keep RPC timing independent and design an explicit, documented handshake-specific policy if slower legitimate upgrades must remain supported.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared timeout contract
recommendation.body: Approve the documented reuse of `requestTimeoutMs` for stalled TCP and Unix upgrades, then refresh the branch and required merge checks.
